q4k_source_expectations.verification_status: Q4K startup completed. Global quantization plan, placement, and capacity are logged; exact per-tensor dtype/layout remain source-based inferences.
q4k_source_expectations.dtype_reason: Qwen3_5 immediate ISQ predicates include all three dense FFN projections. Sensitive-tensor promotion applies to embeddings and lm_head, not dense FFN down/gate/up. Each FFN input dimension is divisible by the Q4K block size, so no Q4_1 fallback is expected on this single-GPU run.
q4k_source_expectations.quantization_source: Eligible blockwise FP8 weights are first dequantized using checkpoint scales and then quantized to the requested GGML format. This is FP8-to-Q4K double quantization, not BF16-source Q4K.
q4k_source_expectations.lm_head_note: The BF16 checkpoint lm_head is also ISQ eligible and is promoted from default Q4K to Q6K; this pair changes eligible projection policy as well as FP8 matrix kernels.
q4k_source_expectations.layout_note: Immediate ISQ disables load_packed_weights, so gate/up have separate stored quantized weight tensors. Mlp::forward calls quantized_ffn, which can fuse gate/up MMVQ computation at batches1-8. Native FP8 startup warms n34816_k5120, consistent with the packed gate/up path. Separate stored tensors do not imply separate gate and up decode kernel launches.
q4k_source_expectations.flash_next_contrast: Flash-Next expert down projections have inner dimension640, so requested Q4K falls back to Q4_1 there; dense27B has inner dimension17408 and retains Q4K.
